reason: The exact standalone SRT tuple cannot deny an unapproved loopback port while permitting the required project listener and receiver ports.

common_contracts: HelperRequest and the built-in parent/child helper
implementation.state: fresh runfs-owned HOME plus one canonical exact settings file
implementation.installation: opaque exact Node and full node_modules inventory binding, rechecked before launch
implementation.project_run_api: not exposed because the mandatory common probe did not qualify

qualification.filesystem_parent_child: observed before the fail-safe aggregate rejection; allowed writes succeeded and outside sentinels remained absent
qualification.network_external_parent_child: unlisted external HTTP was denied and direct external sockets failed
qualification.network_loopback_unapproved_parent_child: failed: all four unapproved-port requests reached the second loopback listener

qualification.fallback: backend fault executed no sentinel and SRT did not retry unsandboxed

commands.command: Context7 resolve/query /anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime for current standalone API, configuration, platform, inheritance, fallback, and cleanup documentation
commands.result: Current official source confirms SRT uses native Seatbelt/bubblewrap, requires explicit settings for fail-closed loading, sets POSIX loopback in NO_PROXY, and exposes no per-loopback-port sandbox rule.

commands.command: npm pack @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime@0.0.73; shasum -a 256 archive; inspect package metadata/source
commands.result: The published archive matched the ADR-pinned SHA-256 and package version. No package code ran during source inspection.

commands.command: copy pinned qualification package.json/package-lock.json to a fresh private temp root; npm ci --ignore-scripts --install-strategy=hoisted --offline
commands.result: Five exact packages installed from the local npm cache; the compiled bounded inventory digest reproduced.

Three live repetitions observed two allowed-loopback hits and four unapproved-loopback hits per common probe, rejected the tuple, reproduced the installation identity, and proved backend failure did not run the fallback sentinel.

commands.command: go test -count=25 ./internal/assurance/sandbox; go test -race -count=5 ./internal/assurance/sandbox; go vet ./internal/assurance/sandbox
commands.result: Candidate adapter, common helper, state, installation identity, process bounds, cleanup, and existing Codex behavior passed repeated/race/vet gates.

commands.command: go test -count=1 ./internal/assurance/...; go test -count=1 ./cmd/openbox; go vet ./internal/assurance/... ./cmd/openbox
commands.result: All assurance packages and the full CLI passed affected module tests and vet.

commands.command: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 and GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go test -exec=true -run '^$' ./internal/assurance/sandbox; gofmt -d; git diff --check
commands.result: The package compiled on Linux and Windows without executing foreign binaries; formatting and whitespace checks were clean. Runtime support is not claimed on those platforms.

limits: This exact Darwin arm64 SRT 0.0.73 tuple is unsupported for project assurance because allowLocalBinding grants direct access to every local port; the accepted gate requires allowed and unapproved loopback to be distinguished.
No weaker profile, Docker fallback, unsandboxed retry, driver switch, or project Run API was added to turn the rejection into a pass.
The current documentation covers newer cross-platform capabilities, but only the exact ADR-pinned 0.0.73 package and Node 22.20.0 bytes were executed here.
The shared process timeout/output/cleanup mechanisms passed, but cannot qualify a tuple that fails its network boundary.
Inherited Claude Code mode remains separately owned by SE-07-07.
